repairs.text: Des de la plaça anem pel carrer dels Til·lers fins a la farmàcia.
repairs.pronunciation: Til·lers has two consecutive lateral L sounds (l·l), a gently lengthened L, never the palatal LL of lluna. Keep the stressed open E and fluent natural Central Catalan. Do not read the middle dot or say the explanation.

repairs.text: D’acord. I després la deixem preparada per al grup. Aquesta vegada em toca prémer el botó a mi!
repairs.pronunciation: Keep Laia/Leda youthful and natural. Pronounce prémer fluently with its M before the final ER, never prémre. Read only the supplied complete turn.

repairs.text: Comprensió oral. El curt que començava pel final.
repairs.pronunciation: Read the exercise introduction and title exactly once in the same youthful Laia/Leda voice. Do not start the dialogue or add a third voice.
